lines.text: Joab sees the king longs for Absalom and sends to Tekoa for a wise woman to pose as a mourner.
The woman tells the king that one of her two sons struck the other in the field and killed him.
The king vows by the LORD that not a hair of her son's head will fall to the ground.
The king tells Joab to bring Absalom back, and Joab goes to Hebron and brings him to Jerusalem.
Joab twice refuses to come to Absalom, so Absalom's servants set fire to Joab's wheat field.
